instruction.text: Decide whether the statement is true or false.

atoms.a: “All men are created equal” is a foundational phrase from the Declaration of Independence.
Historically, the American Dream has been proven to hold true for people of all genders and races.

wrong.text: The American Dream was mostly applicable to white men.

atoms.a: “From rags to riches” describes someone's rise from poverty to wealth.
The American Nightmare describes equal prosperity for all.

wrong.text: The American Nightmare refers to an impossibility of achieving the American Dream.

atoms.a: The American Dream is a key factor that still attracts immigration to the USA.
The USA is considered one of the most socially mobile countries in the world.

wrong.text: It is considered one of the least socially mobile countries.

atoms.a: “Land of opportunity” is a nickname for the USA expressing belief in socioeconomic mobility.
A meritocracy is a system in which success is based on unequal resources.

wrong.text: Meritocracy means that hard work equals success for all people.

atoms.a: The American Dream closely links economic wealth to success.
Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness are core principals of the American Nightmare.

wrong.text: They are principles of the American Dream.

atoms.a: The idea that hard work always prevents poverty is a myth that ignores social and economic inequality.
Upon arrival in America, the Europeans found fully unclaimed resources and land.

wrong.text: The European claim on American land happened at the fatal expense of the Native Americans.

atoms.a: Political tensions add to the idea that the American Dream can also become the American Nightmare.

parentTopic.title: The USA between tradition and change
